_comment: Cover and visibility attributes of the live LOTRLOME_Armory's armour (the <Armor> attributes ArmorComponent.Deserialize reads to show or hide skin, hair, beard and mane).
The Armory is not in this repo, and a reinstall, a mirror sync or an art drop puts old values back. This file holds the intended values; tools/apply_armour_cover_flags.py re-applies them.
rules: a reason and a date each, selecting items by ids, type, mesh or not_mesh (all given keys must match). A rule wins over the snapshot.
snapshot: the value of every covered attribute of every armour item on the date in taken. An attribute that is left out is absent in the item. Rewrite it with --snapshot, never by hand.

rules.reason: Mike: the wearers of these Gondor, Dale and Rhun helmets lost their beard. They were beard all, which hides it; type1 shows it with the engine's mildest trim. Six Gondor ones reverse a mirror commit of 2026-07-25. The ledger also lists harad07_helmet and harad06_v1_helmet, which the Armory no longer has (docs/reference/lotrlome-beard-cover-changes.md).
Mike's audit against docs/reference/helmet-hair-beard-cover.md: the seven Thenn helmets went from beard type3 to type2 (docs/reference/lotrlome-beard-cover-changes.md).
Mike: the Sauron, Witch King and Nazgul helmets cover the whole head, matching the Mouth of Sauron's helm: hair all, beard all, covers_head true (docs/reference/lotrlome-beard-cover-changes.md).
Mike's audit sheet v2: seven Arnor helmets show a beard with type2 (docs/reference/lotrlome-beard-cover-changes.md).

Mike's audit sheet v2: five Arnor helmets show the full beard (docs/reference/lotrlome-beard-cover-changes.md). The sixth row of that table, crown_king_a, is in the crown rule of 2026-11-14, which also gives it beard none.
Mike: every leg piece covers the leg, except shoes that leave the shin bare (docs/modding/items-armor.md rule 5; tools/audit_leg_cover_flags.py).
Mike: the Uruk-hai shoes leave the shin bare, so every item that draws their mesh is covers_legs false.

Mike: a crown or circlet shows all hair and the full beard. Five of these read hair all or beard all before; the other five already complied and are listed so a reset cannot change them. sk_ll_gl_galad_crown_a has neither attribute, which ArmorComponent.Deserialize reads as none (the attribute absent means None), so none is added. This rule wins over the Arnor row of 2026-10-05 for sk_ar_art_crown_king_a.
